text: Blondine is a heroine of Brittany. She appears in a folktale of that land. The tale is rich with myth signs. Some readers name her a fallen goddess. A youth called Cado mocked a fairy. The fairy then cast a spell. Only a princess could break that spell. She was called Blondine. No man could guide Cado to her land. He heard crows speaking about her. They told him the way. Cado rode on the back of a crow. The bird led him to Blondine. She waited by a good well. Cado took her from her wizard father. The father fired weak spells as they ran. On the earth Cado broke his promise. He lost the ring she had pressed on him. He forgot her completely. He planned to wed another. Blondine came to that wedding in her ring. Cado then recalled his true bride. The two were wed at last.

okr.objective: Describe Blondine, the Breton maiden who could break a fairy's curse.
key_results: Blondine can be met in a folktale of Brittany.
Cado was placed under the spell only she could cast away.
He came to her by riding on a crow's back.
They were married at last in the tale.
